name: @cmp/blast-radius
description: Deterministic dependency blast-radius and critical-path AST CLI for the CMP monorepo

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.chmodSync('dist/src/cli.js', 0o755);"
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; const walk = (d) => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes: true}).flatMap((e) => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d, e.name)) : [path.join(d, e.name)]); for (const f of walk('src')) { if (!f.endsWith('.ts')) continue; const s = fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8'); if (s.includes('@ts-ignore')) { console.error('Disallowed @ts-ignore in ' + f); process.exit(1); } } console.log('@cmp/blast-radius lint passed.');"
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.chmodSync('dist/src/cli.js', 0o755);" && node --test dist/test/*.test.js
